content.short: Collect, earn and fight! Cardano Legends is a turn-based combat game on the Cardano Blockchain.
content.description:
Cardano Legends is an upcoming action turn-based play-to-earn game, built on the Cardano blockchain. You must build your team with mighty legends to defeat your foes, fight other players, upgrade your warriors and earn currency with real life value.

All of the CardanoLegends NFT minted during drops will be playable in-game!
